'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Keith Brown DS Wookiee Slaving Operation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Keith Brown]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Keith Brown / DJK1, 2014 Worlds Day 2, 2010 form.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Wookiee Slaving Operation / Indentured To The Empire]]
* '''Username:''' DJK1
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
